company.name: Keychain Logistics
company.shortDescription: Keychain Logistics utilizes mobile technology to bridge the logistical gap between shippers and carriers of freight.
company.description: Keychain Logistics is a software marketplace that directly connects companies shipping products with independent semi-truck owner-operators. The platform effectively cuts out the traditional third-party logistics brokerage process by virtue of a software enabled network of virtual carriers (trucks on the go in our network). They understand where trucks in their network are at any given moment, their capacity, and if they would be an ideal match for a company shipping.

productsAndServices.description: A mobile technology platform that connects shippers and carriers to facilitate freight transportation coordination.
productsAndServices.name: Mobile Freight Logistics Platform
